description: Add a node to the edited scene (undoable). Provide either 'type' (a class like 'Sprite2D') or 'scene' (a res:// .tscn to instance). Initial properties are validated before anything is changed. Value formats: Vector2/3 as [x, y(, z)] or {x, y}; Color as '#rrggbb', '#rrggbbaa', a name like 'red', or [r, g, b, a] in 0..1; NodePath/StringName as strings; Rect2 as [x, y, w, h]; resources as {"res": "res://path"} for a file, or {"new": "RectangleShape2D", "properties": {"size": [32, 48]}} to create an embedded one (shapes, materials, styles; not scripts); null clears. Nested fields can be set with Godot's indexed syntax, e.g. "position:x".

dry_run.description: Preview only: validate and describe the change without applying it.

name.description: Node name (made unique among siblings if taken).

parent.description: Parent node. Node path relative to the edited scene's root; '.' is the root itself (e.g. 'Player/Sprite2D'). Default '.'.

scene.description: res:// path of a scene to instance instead of 'type'.

name: node_add
title: Add node
